Using Au-Cu as a model binary alloy, we formulate cubic and quartic cluster-expansion Hamiltonians as penalty-augmented polynomial unconstrained binary optimization (PUBO) problems under fixed-composition constraints. We optimize these PUBO problems using SQBM+, a simulated-bifurcation-based solver that can treat higher-order polynomial binary objectives directly. This direct PUBO treatment avoids the need to construct an explicit quadratic reformulation with auxiliary variables. Composition constraints are imposed through quadratic penalty terms, whose weights are estimated from derivative coefficients of the continuous relaxation of the CE objective. Benchmark calculations for systems up to 2048 atoms show that SQBM+ robustly obtains low-energy feasible configurations for cubic CE models and remains effective for many quartic instances. Formation-energy convex hulls constructed from the optimized configurations recover the CuAu and Cu3Au ordering trends and reveal finite-size effects at off-stoichiometric compositions. These results demonstrate simulated bifurcation as a practical route to constrained higher-order CE optimization for alloy configuration search.

AI.tldr: 该论文将高阶团簇展开(CE)哈密顿量表述为带罚函数的PUBO问题，用模拟分岔求解器SQBM+直接优化，实现二元合金(Au-Cu)基态与低能构型搜索。
AI.motivation: 识别基态与低能原子构型是合金设计的核心问题。CE方法对二元合金会产生高阶(多项式)Ising哈密顿量，而传统二次化需要引入辅助变量，且固定组分约束的处理存在困难，因此需要能直接处理高阶多项式目标的优化方法。
AI.method: 以Au-Cu为模型体系，将三次和四次CE哈密顿量写成固定组分约束下的罚增强PUBO问题；通过二次罚项施加组分约束，罚权重由CE目标连续松弛的导数系数估计；用基于模拟分岔的SQBM+求解器直接优化高阶多项式二值目标，避免显式二次重构与辅助变量。
AI.result: 在最多2048原子的体系上，SQBM+能稳健获得三次CE模型的低能可行构型，对多数四次实例也有效；由优化构型构建的形成能凸包重现了CuAu和Cu3Au有序化趋势，并揭示非化学计量组分下的有限尺寸效应。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明模拟分岔是求解带约束高阶CE优化、进行合金构型搜索的一条实用途径。

title: Resolving the ground state intersection problem in coupled cluster theory
summary: A physically correct description of ground state conical intersections is essential for simulating non-adiabatic dynamics of radiationless decay to the electronic ground state. Coupled cluster theory offers a particularly balanced treatment of static and dynamic correlation in excited states. However, coupled cluster methods and other single-reference approaches fail to describe ground state intersection regions, and several workarounds have been proposed to address this shortcoming. Here we present convex similarity constrained coupled cluster theory (CVX-SCC), a framework that resolves the ground state intersection problem by construction. We have applied this theory to two different coupled cluster methods, and tested the resulting models on ethylene, uracil, PSB3, and HeH$_2$, showing that both variants produce physically correct ground state conical intersections. With future development of nuclear gradients and non-adiabatic coupling vectors, this approach will provide single-reference electronic structures suitable for non-adiabatic dynamics simulations all the way to the ground state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出凸相似性约束耦合簇理论（CVX-SCC），通过构造方式解决基态锥形交叉无法描述的问题，并在乙烯、尿嘧啶、PSB3和HeH2上验证了其物理正确性。
AI.motivation: 准确描述基态锥形交叉对模拟向电子基态的无辐射衰减非绝热动力学至关重要。耦合簇理论能平衡处理激发态的静态与动态相关，但耦合簇等单参考方法无法描述基态交叉区域，已有多种权宜方案存在不足。
AI.method: 提出凸相似性约束耦合簇理论（CVX-SCC），将该框架应用于两种不同的耦合簇方法，并在乙烯、尿嘧啶、PSB3和HeH2四个体系上测试所得模型。
AI.result: 两个CVX-SCC变体均能产生物理正确的基态锥形交叉。
AI.conclusion: CVX-SCC从构造上解决了基态交叉问题；未来若发展核梯度和非绝热耦合矢量，该方法可提供适用于直至基态的非绝热动力学模拟的单参考电子结构。

title: Reconfigurable field-free spin Hall nano-oscillators enabled by crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt
summary: Spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) are nanoscale microwave sources for wireless communication, neuromorphic computing and oscillator-based Ising machines, but conventional devices require a global magnetic bias. Here we replace this bias through crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt. Growth of hcp Co with its c-axis in the film plane produces an anisotropy field of about 0.36 T and enables field-free auto-oscillations above 10 GHz in nanoconstriction SHNOs. The active current polarity is selected by the remanent magnetization, providing nonvolatile reconfiguration of the oscillation state. Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering confirms that the nonlinear response is confined to the nanoconstriction region. Lithographic control of the angle between the current and anisotropy axes tunes the excitation threshold and drives two spectral branches from separated modes to a dominant single branch, consistent with mutual synchronization. These results establish epitaxial crystallographic anisotropy as a route to reconfigurable field-free spintronic oscillators and oscillator networks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用外延Co/Pt的晶体各向异性替代全局磁场偏置，实现无外场下的自振荡自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNO）。
AI.motivation: 传统SHNO需要全局磁场偏置，限制了其在无线通信、类脑计算和伊辛机中的集成与应用，因此需要实现无场工作的SHNO。
AI.method: 在薄膜面内生长c轴取向的hcp Co外延Co/Pt，产生约0.36 T的各向异性场；采用纳米收缩结构SHNO，并通过微聚焦布里渊光散射表征非线性响应，同时用光刻控制电流与各向异性轴夹角。
AI.result: 实现10 GHz以上无场自振荡；各向异性场约0.36 T；残余磁化决定有源电流极性，实现非易失振荡状态重构；非线性响应局限于纳米收缩区；调节电流与各向异性轴夹角可调整激发阈值，并驱动两个谱支从分离模式转为单一主导支（与互同步一致）。
AI.conclusion: 外延晶体各向异性为可重构、无场自旋电子振荡器及振荡器网络提供了一条新途径。

title: Heteroepitaxial Growth of PbSe on InP Substrates via Lattice-Matched III-V Buffer Layers
summary: Detector cost remains a barrier to the widespread adoption of mid-wave infrared (3-5 micron) technology. PbSe, an inexpensive narrow band gap IV-VI semiconductor that has been used since the early 1940s, delivers high performance for infrared detection despite the abundance of grain boundaries in polycrystalline films. Epitaxial growth, however, could provide superior crystalline quality and interfaces, but suitable substrates remain limited for PbSe. Recent PbSe heteroepitaxy has focused primarily on III-V, II-VI and group-IV substrates that each offer a comparatively narrow range of lattice-matched alloys for heterostructure engineering. Here we show that InP-based heteroepitaxy provides access to a broader materials platform while limiting the lattice mismatch with PbSe to approximately 4%. We grow 150-nm thick PbSe films by molecular beam epitaxy on 200-nm thick In0.53Ga0.47As and In0.52Al0.48As buffers on (001) InP substrates. Reflection high-energy electron diffraction and X-ray diffraction show (001)-oriented rock-salt PbSe with an out-of-plane lattice constant of 6.12 Angstrom on both buffers. Photoluminescence (PL) is observed from room-temperature down to 12 K and the peak wavelength red-shifts from 3.7 to 5.0 microns. Under identical measurement conditions, the room-temperature peak PL intensities from films on In0.53Ga0.47As and In0.52Al0.48As are approximately 1.9x and 1.3x that of a PbSe on GaAs substrate reference, respectively. These results establish an InP-compatible platform for integrating narrow band-gap PbSe with a broad range of ternary and quaternary III-V alloys, including, for example, structures in which In0.53Ga0.47As serves as both a short-wave infrared absorber and a template for PbSe growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究展示在InP衬底上通过InGaAs/InAlAs缓冲层异质外延PbSe薄膜，实现约4%晶格失配，获得高质量(001)岩盐结构PbSe并观察到室温光致发光，为低成本中波红外探测提供InP兼容平台。
AI.motivation: 中波红外探测器成本高阻碍其广泛应用。PbSe是廉价窄带隙半导体，多晶薄膜性能虽好但晶界多；外延生长可提升晶体质量，然而适用衬底有限，现有III-V、II-VI及IV族衬底可匹配合金范围较窄，限制了异质结构工程。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延在(001) InP衬底上生长200 nm厚的In0.53Ga0.47As和In0.52Al0.48As缓冲层，再生长150 nm厚PbSe薄膜。通过反射高能电子衍射和X射线衍射表征结构与晶格常数，并在室温至12 K温度范围测量光致发光。
AI.result: PbSe在两种缓冲层上均为(001)取向岩盐结构，面外晶格常数6.12 Å。室温至12 K均观测到光致发光，峰值波长从3.7 μm红移至5.0 μm。相同测量条件下，In0.53Ga0.47As和In0.52Al0.48As上薄膜的室温峰值PL强度分别约为GaAs衬底PbSe参考样的1.9倍和1.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了InP兼容平台，可将窄带隙PbSe与广泛的三元和四元III-V合金集成，例如In0.53Ga0.47As可同时充当短波红外吸收层和PbSe生长模板。

title: Renewal process's guide to fractional Navier-Stokes equations
summary: The Navier-Stokes equations, which remain unsolved, are crucial equations in fluid mechanics. Discovering the solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations is one of the challenging Millennium problems. In 1900, Hilbert proposed a potential approach to tackle this problem by establishing the relationship between microscopic dynamics and the macroscopic continuum equations. The key bridge is the derivation of Boltzmann equation and the theory of probability. In this paper, we shall use the collision renewal process with arbitrarily distributed waiting times to derive the Boltzmann equation for the time evolution of the probability of the velocity and the displacement of the particle, based on which we prove that the renewal process with exponential collision waiting time is equivalent to the classical Navier-Stokes equations, and that with power-law waiting time is equivalent to the fractional Navier-Stokes equations. Since the collision renewal process with arbitrarily distributed waiting times is a random process and is easy to perform the stochastic simulations of trajectories to obtain the corresponding solution, we actually find a stochastic approach to solve the classical and fractional Navier-Stokes equations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用具有任意分布等待时间的碰撞更新过程推导Boltzmann方程，证明指数等待时间对应经典Navier-Stokes方程、幂律等待时间对应分数阶Navier-Stokes方程，从而给出求解这两类方程的随机方法。
AI.motivation: Navier-Stokes方程是流体力学中的核心未解难题，也是千禧年难题之一。Hilbert提出通过建立微观动力学与宏观连续方程之间联系来攻克此问题，其关键桥梁是Boltzmann方程的推导与概率理论。
AI.method: 本文采用具有任意分布等待时间的碰撞更新过程（collision renewal process）来推导描述粒子速度与位移概率随时间演化的Boltzmann方程。
AI.result: 证明了具有指数碰撞等待时间的更新过程等价于经典Navier-Stokes方程，而具有幂律等待时间的更新过程等价于分数阶Navier-Stokes方程。
AI.conclusion: 由于该碰撞更新过程是随机过程，易于通过随机模拟轨迹来获得相应解，因此本文实际上找到了求解经典与分数阶Navier-Stokes方程的一种随机方法。

title: Semi-Dirac States and Quantum Linear Magnetoresistance in Helimagnetic Pnictide MnP
summary: Large linear positive magnetoresistance (LPMR) in topological and magnetic materials remains a subject of intense debate, particularly in noncollinear spin systems where spin-dependent scattering complicates charge transport. Manganese phosphide (MnP), a helimagnetic binary pnictide with multiple field-induced magnetic transitions, provides a useful platform to investigate the interplay between complex magnetism and electronic topology. Here, we present a comprehensive experimental and theoretical investigation of phase-dependent magnetotransport in high-quality MnP single crystals. Hall measurements reveal an anomalous Hall effect dominated by skew scattering at high temperatures and a finite topological Hall effect in the noncollinear fan (FAN) and low-temperature screw (SCR) phases. At low temperatures, we observe a large, non-saturating LPMR reaching nearly 800 percent at 4 K and 15 T, with a pronounced linear field dependence in the field-polarized ferromagnetic (FM2) state. First-principles calculations reveal a strongly anisotropic semi-Dirac-like band at the Y point that progressively approaches the Fermi level from the SCR to FAN and FM2 states. Our analysis indicates that the resulting small Fermi pocket can access the extreme quantum-limit regime at experimentally accessible fields, providing a microscopic framework for the observed LPMR within Abrikosov's quantum magnetoresistance theory.

AI.tldr: 本文综合实验与理论研究高质量MnP单晶的相依赖磁输运，发现非共线FAN和SCR相中的拓扑霍尔效应，及低温下近800%的线性正磁阻，并用半狄拉克能带与量子极限解释其机制。
AI.motivation: 拓扑与磁性材料中的大线性正磁阻（LPMR）成因争议大，尤其非共线自旋系统中自旋相关散射使电荷输运复杂。MnP作为具有多重场诱导磁转变的螺旋磁二元磷族化合物，是研究复杂磁性与电子拓扑相互作用的理想平台。
AI.method: 对高质量MnP单晶进行霍尔测量，识别反常霍尔与拓扑霍尔效应；开展第一性原理计算，分析Y点强各向异性半狄拉克能带随SCR→FAN→FM2态的演化及其与费米能级的关系。
AI.result: 霍尔测量显示高温下由斜散射主导的反常霍尔效应，非共线FAN和低温SCR相中存在有限拓扑霍尔效应；低温4 K、15 T下观察到近800%的非饱和LPMR，在FM2态呈明显线性场依赖；计算表明小费米口袋可在实验可及磁场进入极端量子极限。
AI.conclusion: MnP中观测到的LPMR可依据Abrikosov量子磁阻理论，由半狄拉克能带形成的小费米口袋进入量子极限来解释，为复杂磁性与电子拓扑耦合下的磁输运提供了微观框架。

title: Efficient Deterministic-Stochastic Representation of the Coulomb Operator in Real Space
summary: We present an efficient mixed deterministic-stochastic approach for constructing the Coulomb operator in real space that preserves accuracy across the full spectral range. The dominant long-range components of the interaction are captured deterministically via a compact, low-rank approximation, constructed using Chebyshev-filtered subspace iteration, while the remaining spectral tail is treated using unbiased probing with a small number of stochastic vectors. The resulting operator is benchmarked within self-consistent field calculations for the extended Hubbard Hamiltonian on periodic, perturbed, and non-periodic three-dimensional lattices. We account for stochastic bias in observables by implementing a jackknife correction. The method systematically improves with deterministic rank and stochastic sample count, while substantially reducing the computational cost of constructing the Coulomb matrix.

AI.tldr: 提出一种确定性与随机性混合的方法构建实空间库仑算符，兼顾全谱精度并大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 构建库仑矩阵的计算代价高，需要在保持全谱精度的同时降低开销。
AI.method: 用Chebyshev滤波子空间迭代获得紧凑低秩近似来确定性捕捉长程主导成分，剩余谱尾用少量随机向量的无偏探测处理；在SCF计算中测试扩展Hubbard模型，并用jackknife校正随机偏差。
AI.result: 在周期性、扰动及非周期性三维晶格上验证，随确定性秩和随机样本数增加系统性改善，同时显著降低库仑矩阵构建成本。
AI.conclusion: 该混合确定性-随机方法在保持精度的同时高效构建库仑算符，具备系统性可调性。

title: Quench dynamics in nonreciprocal Aubry-André-Harper model
summary: The critical phase of a non-Hermitian quasicrystal can support stronger transport than its surrounding delocalized phase. We demonstrate this anomalous behavior in the one-dimensional nonreciprocal Aubry-André-Harper model through a combined study of dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) and wavepacket diffusion. Using a parity-sorted energy-spectrum classification that directly encodes the generalized $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry, we find that DQPTs in this system are energy-resolved, in contrast to the energy-independent DQPTs of Hermitian quasicrystals. The energy-resolved features are most pronounced when the initial and final Hamiltonians belong to different phases (localized or extended), and they are tied to the even-odd index structure of the spectrum, which we exploit to organize the quench-dynamical landscape. For wavepacket dynamics after a single-site quench, the diffusion exponent $β$, extracted from the long-time power-law scaling of the root-mean-square displacement $σ(τ)$, partitions the phase diagram into four distinct regimes. In the Hermitian limit the extended phase is ballistic ($β=1$), the critical phase is normally diffusive ($β=0.5$), and the localized phase yields $β\to 0$. Nonreciprocity reverses this hierarchy: the extended phase becomes normally diffusive, while the critical phase turns ballistic. We trace the anomalous $β=1$ at criticality to the self-similar multifractal structure of the critical eigenstates, whose nodal positions are organized by the golden ratio. A finite-size scaling ansatz built on the wave-front propagation yields $σ(τ)\proptoτ$. The parity-resolved DQPTs and the $β$-phase diagram establish two complementary dynamical diagnostics of nonreciprocal quasicrystals, in which nonreciprocity promotes transport at the critical point and suppresses it in the delocalized phase.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维非互易Aubry-André-Harper模型，揭示非厄米准晶临界相可比周围离域相具有更强输运的反常行为，并通过动力学量子相变(DQPT)与波包扩散给出两类互补的动力学诊断。
AI.motivation: 通常临界点输运被认为弱于离域相，但非厄米准晶中临界相可能支持更强输运，缺乏系统的动力学刻画。作者希望用DQPT与波包扩散统一理解非互易准晶的相与输运。
AI.method: 采用宇称排序的能量谱分类(编码广义PT对称)，区分能量分辨的DQPT；对单点淬火后的波包计算均方位移σ(τ)的长时间幂律标度，提取扩散指数β；并基于波前传播的有限尺度标度分析临界自相似多重分形本征态(节点位置由黄金比组织)。
AI.result: DQPT在该系统中能量分辨，初始与末态哈密顿量属不同相(局域/扩展)时最显著，且与谱的奇偶指标结构相关。β将相图分为四个区域：厄米极限下扩展相弹道β=1、临界相正常扩散β=0.5、局域相β→0；非互易性反转层级，扩展相变为正常扩散、临界相变为弹道β=1，标度给出σ(τ)∝τ。
AI.conclusion: 宇称分辨DQPT与β相图构成非互易准晶的两类互补动力学诊断：非互易性在临界点增强输运、在离域相抑制输运。

title: Twist and strain identification in moiré heterostructures
summary: The geometrical and electronic properties of moiré materials are highly sensitive to the twist and strain in the samples due to the moiré magnifying effect. Accurate identification of twist and strain in moiré materials is therefore essential. In this work, we establish a general framework to extract the twist and strain configurations from moiré images with either atomic or moiré scale resolution. With only moiré-wavelength information, we show that there is a continuous family of possible twist and strain configurations, each one accounting for different orientations of the moiré pattern. To estimate the most likely twist-strain configuration, we discuss additional constraints and methods involving the minimum elastic energy and the electronic spectra. The minimum elastic energy, in particular, reflects that shear configurations become much more favorable as the strain increases. As an example of the developed methodology, we discuss the formation and identification of strained triangular moiré patterns. Our framework provides a comprehensive approach to identify the twist and strain configurations in systems with moiré-scale resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用框架，从摩尔图像（原子或摩尔尺度分辨率）中提取扭转与应变构型，并利用弹性势能最小化和电子谱等约束确定最可能的构型。
AI.motivation: 摩尔材料的几何与电子性质对扭转和应变高度敏感（摩尔放大效应），因此准确识别扭转和应变构型至关重要。
AI.method: 建立从摩尔图像提取扭转-应变构型的通用框架；指出仅凭摩尔波长信息存在连续简并的扭转-应变家族（对应不同摩尔图样取向）；引入额外约束，包括最小弹性势能和电子谱，来估计最可能的构型。
AI.result: 最小弹性势能分析表明，随应变增大，剪切构型变得更加有利；并以应变三角形摩尔图样的形成与识别为例验证了方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在摩尔尺度分辨率系统中识别扭转与应变构型提供了全面方法。

title: Intermittent continuous-time random walks under renewal reset mechanism
summary: Stochastic resetting as a practical and efficient search strategy in complex and disordered environments has long been a topic of interest to researchers. Based on the competition between jumping and resetting, this article proposes and investigates intermittent continuous-time random walks (CTRWs) under stochastic resetting, using the smaller waiting time for jump and reset as the renewal time, where the waiting times for both jump and reset can have arbitrary distributions. After each renewal event, the system will proceed with new waiting times for jump and reset regardless of their previous histories. We study the governing equation and Montroll-Weiss equation with renewal resetting, as well as the Markovian resetting for intermittent CTRWs. We prove the existence of non-equilibrium stationary states within the renewal reset mechanism when the jump and reset waiting times follow any exponential and power law distributions. For exponential and Gaussian distributed jump lengths, we examine the mean square displacements (MSDs) of particles to determine their monotonicity and asymptotic stability. Moreover, we calculate the first-arrival time to quantify search efficiency, and validate the intermittent CTRWs under renewal resetting lead to a finite mean first-arrival time (MFAT) to any fixed position for exponential jump and reset waiting time distributions (WTDs), power-law jump and exponential reset WTDs, as well as exponential jump and power-law reset WTDs. However, the MFAT diverges for power-law jump and reset WTDs. The intermittent CTRW model, which is based on the competition mechanism, can be applied to many physical scenarios, such as the foraging strategy of animals that return to their nests after an unsuccessful foraging attempt, or the work planning of intelligent robots that return to energy replenishment points after prolonged operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究基于跳跃与重置竞争的间歇性连续时间随机游走（CTRW）模型，重置时间取跳跃与重置等待时间中的较小值，并分析其稳态、均方位移与首次到达时间。
AI.motivation: 随机重置作为复杂无序环境中高效搜索策略备受关注，现有研究多基于跳跃与重置的竞争关系，但等待时间分布可任意的间歇性CTRW在随机重置下的性质尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 以跳跃与重置等待时间的较小值作为更新时刻，建立间歇性CTRW模型；推导含更新重置的主方程与Montroll-Weiss方程，并考虑马尔可夫重置情形；分析跳跃与重置等待时间服从指数及幂律分布时的非平衡稳态；对指数与高斯跳跃长度计算MSD的单调性与渐近稳定性，并计算首次到达时间。
AI.result: 证明了更新重置机制下当跳跃与重置等待时间服从任意指数或幂律分布时非平衡稳态存在；对指数跳跃+指数重置、幂律跳跃+指数重置、指数跳跃+幂律重置的等待时间分布，首次到达时间（MFAT）有限；而幂律跳跃+幂律重置时MFAT发散。
AI.conclusion: 基于竞争机制的间歇性CTRW模型可有效刻画搜索效率，并适用于动物觅食后归巢、智能机器人长时间运行后返回充电点等实际物理场景。

title: SIM-GRAPH: A universal guide to symmetric interactions
summary: Symmetry plays a central role throughout physics, from Fourier analysis on discrete lattices to the classification of elementary particles in the standard model. In finite quantum systems, symmetries are often discrete, such as reflection and rotational symmetries. Here, we present the SIM-GRAPH method (Symmetric Ising Models - Graph Reduction And Projected Hamiltonians), which uses such symmetries to efficiently calculate ground-state observables of interacting quantum systems. By projecting all interactions onto a symmetric subset of the system, the method effectively reduces the number of sites, thus providing an exponential speedup over standard exact diagonalization. Furthermore, we introduce two extensions that broaden the applicability of the method and allow for a controlled trade-off between computational cost and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出SIM-GRAPH方法，利用离散对称性将相互作用投影到对称子集，指数级加速量子系统基态可观测量的计算，并提供两种扩展以权衡成本与精度。
AI.motivation: 有限量子系统中对称性（如反射、旋转）普遍存在，但标准精确对角化计算基态可观测量的成本随系统规模指数增长，亟需利用对称性降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: SIM-GRAPH（Symmetric Ising Models - Graph Reduction And Projected Hamiltonians）：将所有相互作用投影到系统的一个对称子集上，等效减少格点数目，从而降低希尔伯特空间维度；并引入两种扩展以扩大适用范围，实现计算成本与精度的可控权衡。
AI.result: 相比标准精确对角化，该方法实现指数级加速，能够高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量。
AI.conclusion: 利用离散对称性的投影与图约化可显著降低量子多体计算的复杂度，两种扩展进一步增强了方法的通用性和灵活性。

title: Direct separation of intra- and inter-molecular contributions in pulse dipolar EPR experiments
summary: We present a direct method of separating intra- (form factor) and inter-molecular (background) contri- butions in pulse EPR dipolar spectroscopy (PDS) experiments. The form factor/background separation is accomplished by rearranging data measured at two different biradical concentrations, without any fitting fundamentally required. This new data processing method allows to analyse PDS data from spin concen- trated samples for which background separation was previously unrealistic. In particular, the presented method would be of high importance for studies of spin labeled biomolecules, especially in respect to the liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Furthermore, we propose a simple measurement and data processing protocol to separate the PDS contributions from each phase in LLPS samples. The protocol for the form factor/background separation for RIDME experiment is also discussed

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种直接分离脉冲EPR偶极谱(PDS)中分子内(形式因子)与分子间(背景)贡献的新方法，通过重组两个不同双自由基浓度下的测量数据实现，无需拟合，可用于高自旋浓度样品，并针对液-液相分离(LLPS)提出测量与处理协议。
AI.motivation: 传统PDS中形式因子与背景的分离依赖拟合，对于自旋浓度高的样品背景分离往往不现实，限制了在自旋标记生物分子（尤其LLPS）研究中的应用。
AI.method: 通过在不同双自由基浓度下测量两组数据并对其进行代数重组，实现形式因子/背景的直接分离，基本无需拟合；同时提出针对LLPS样品分离各相PDS贡献的测量与数据处理协议，并讨论了RIDME实验的分离方案。
AI.result: 方法实现了无需拟合的形式因子/背景分离，使此前无法处理的高自旋浓度PDS数据得以分析，并给出LLPS各相贡献分离的可行协议及RIDME的实施方案。
AI.conclusion: 该直接分离方法拓展了PDS的适用样品范围，对自旋标记生物分子尤其是LLPS研究具有重要价值。

title: WannierNLQG: A Julia package for nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry from Wannier tight-binding models
summary: Nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry are central to modern condensed matter physics and are deeply intertwined. We introduce WannierNLQG, an extensible Julia framework for computing nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometric quantities from Wannier tight-binding models. Its gauge-consistent, degeneracy-aware architecture accommodates perturbative responses at arbitrary order and additional quantum geometric quantities. The current release evaluates ordinary, spin, and photon-drag injection and shift currents, as Brillouin-zone integrals and on k slices. For shift current, a unified interface exposes four complementary formulations: the conventional method, projector trace, generalized Wilson loop, and a finite-momentum geometric loop, with the last three explicitly accommodating degenerate subspaces. The framework also provides k-resolved Berry curvature, quantum metric, their multipoles, and additional quantum geometric and mixed momentum-spin quantities. Experimental symmetry workflows additionally support symmetry-adapted Wannier construction, symmetrization of tight-binding models and real-space operators, and reduction of spatially uniform response integrals to irreducible k-point orbits and invariant tensor components. The documentation covers formula conventions, the TaskConfig interface, and auditable output formats, with GeS and bilayer MoS2 case studies illustrating method comparison, degeneracy handling, quantum geometric analysis, and photon-drag responses. Together, these capabilities enable first-principles calculations of nonlinear response and quantum geometry in realistic multiband materials, connecting quantum geometry with quantitative materials modeling for optoelectronic, spintronic, and photovoltaic applications.

AI.tldr: WannierNLQG：基于Wannier紧束缚模型的Julia框架，计算非线性光响应与量子几何量。
AI.motivation: 非线性光响应与量子几何紧密关联，但缺乏统一、规范一致且能处理简并的工具。
AI.method: 采用Wannier紧束缚模型，规范一致、可处理简并，支持任意阶微扰响应；位移电流提供四种互补公式（常规、投影迹、广义Wilson loop、有限动量几何loop），后三者显式处理简并子空间；并提供k分辨Berry曲率、量子度规及其多极矩等。
AI.result: 支持普通/自旋/光子拖拽注入与位移电流的BZ积分及k切片计算；含对称性工作流（对称适应Wannier构造、模型与实空间算符对称化、积分约化到不可约k点）；以GeS与双层MoS2为案例展示方法比较、简并处理与光子拖拽响应。
AI.conclusion: 为多带真实材料提供第一性原理非线性响应与量子几何计算能力，连接量子几何与光电、自旋电子与光伏等材料建模。

title: Automated Generation of Commensurate Magnetic Structures based on Spin Space Groups and Graph Theory
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, supplementary will be in the published journal
summary: Magnetic structures with symmetry constraints are candidates for energetically favorable configurations. Enumerating these structures is essential for identifying experimental observations and provides unbiased, linearly stable, and optimally sampled reference configurations for energy fitting when extracting spin interactions. We present SpinGraph, an automated workflow generating symmetry-distinct magnetic configurations. SpinGraph is not only compatible with the more general spin space groups, but also allows precise control of the prescribed single- or multi-Q states superposition. For finite groups, we enumerate compatible subgroups directly. For spin space groups with a continuous or special spin-only part, the finite component is enumerated first and then combined with the compatible exact spin-only constraints. These actions are translated into graph constraints in real or Fourier space. The symmetry of every generated structure is re-evaluated after construction. Finally, we integrate SpinGraph with the magnetic analysis code AMATIS to perform a thorough calculation for the spin interactions of the insulating monolayer CrI3. SpinGraph complements the last part of AMATIS and realizes the fully automated workflow for the spin Hamiltonian construction, which is essential for studying phase transitions, spin textures, magnons, and spin dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpinGraph，一个自动生成对称性区分磁构型的工作流，兼容自旋空间群并支持单/多Q态叠加的精确控制，最终集成 AMATIS 实现自旋哈密顿量构建的全自动化。
AI.motivation: 满足对称性约束的磁结构是能量有利构型的候选；枚举这些结构对识别实验观测以及为能量拟合提供无偏、线性稳定、最优采样的参考构型至关重要。
AI.method: SpinGraph 兼容更一般的自旋空间群，可精确控制单/多Q态叠加。对有限群直接枚举兼容子群；对含连续或特殊纯自旋部分的自旋空间群，先枚举有限分量再结合精确的纯自旋约束。这些操作被转化为实空间或傅里叶空间的图约束，且每个生成结构构建后会重新评估其对称性。
AI.result: 将 SpinGraph 与磁性分析代码 AMATIS 集成，对绝缘单层 CrI3 的自旋相互作用进行了完整计算。
AI.conclusion: SpinGraph 补全了 AMATIS 的最后部分，实现了自旋哈密顿量构建的全自动化工作流，对研究相变、自旋织构、磁振子和自旋动力学至关重要。

title: Quantifying cell shape and density fluctuations in epithelial tissue in vivo
summary: Controlling changes in cell shape are crucial for many biological processes, such as tissue development and wound healing. Tissues typically are heterogeneous with a variety of cell shapes and sizes. Of particular interest are local deviations from an average cell shape and size. These fluctuations may extend and transmit across tissues, potentially offering valuable insights into tissue characteristics such as variations in effective "stiffness" or rigidity. In this study, we present a theoretical framework that captures the dynamics of epithelial cell shapes within tissue, incorporating both their average behaviour and fluctuation patterns. We model cells as interacting soft ellipsoids of varying size and aspect ratio. Coarse-graining our model, we obtain a set of continuum stochastic differential equations from which we derive spatial-temporal correlation functions. These correlation functions fit with our experimental data from the developmental process of the \textit{Drosophila} pupal wing. From the correlation functions, critical parameters representing active cell shape changes and effective tissue "stiffness" can be determined.

AI.tldr: 本文建立理论框架，将上皮细胞视为可变大小与长宽比的软椭球，粗粒化得到连续随机微分方程，推导时空关联函数，并与果蝇蛹翅实验数据拟合，从而提取活性细胞形变与组织有效刚度等关键参数。
AI.motivation: 组织通常具有异质的细胞形状与大小，局部偏离平均形状的涨落可跨组织传播，可能揭示组织的有效"刚度"等特性，因此需要能同时刻画平均行为与涨落模式的理论框架。
AI.method: 将细胞建模为相互作用的软椭球（大小与长宽比可变），对模型进行粗粒化，得到一组连续随机微分方程，并据此推导时空关联函数；再用果蝇蛹翅发育过程的实验数据进行拟合。
AI.result: 推导出的时空关联函数与果蝇蛹翅发育实验数据吻合，并可由关联函数确定表征活性细胞形变与组织有效"刚度"的关键参数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能统一描述上皮细胞形状的平均行为与涨落，并通过与实验关联函数拟合来定量提取组织的活性与力学特性。

title: Phonon-Bottleneck-Governed Ultrafast Hot-Carrier Super-Diffusion in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
summary: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are promising for low-power optoelectronics, yet their operational speed is widely considered constrained by low room-temperature mobilities and carrier transit delays. Here, by combining on-chip terahertz optoelectronic sampling with thermally evaporated Ohmic contacts, we eliminate external parasitic delays and directly capture the intrinsic interfacial photoresponse in unencapsulated TMDCs under zero bias. The devices achieve ultrafast relaxation lifetimes of 48.5 ps in MoS2/Au and 14.2 ps in MoSe2/Ag, translating to intrinsic 3-dB bandwidths of 4.4 GHz and 7.5 GHz, respectively. Spatial scanning and bias-dependent measurements show that this response is position-independent and bias-immune, ruling out conventional drift-limited transport and identifying hot-carrier super-diffusion driven by an interfacial electron temperature gradient as the operative mechanism. Furthermore, ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy reveals that the macroscopic response time is quantitatively synchronized with the microscopic optical-to-acoustic phonon scattering lifetime governed by the intrinsic phonon bottleneck. Our findings establish phonon engineering as a viable paradigm to tailor non-equilibrium optoelectronic dynamics, offering a blueprint for zero-bias, ultrafast, self-powered devices.

AI.tldr: 通过片上太赫兹采样与热蒸发欧姆接触，直接测得TMDCs零偏下的本征界面光响应，本征带宽达4.4 GHz(MoS2/Au)和7.5 GHz(MoSe2/Ag)，机制为热载流子超扩散并由声子瓶颈主导。
AI.motivation: 二维TMDCs被视为低功耗光电子材料的候选，但其工作速度普遍被认为受限于室温低迁移率和载流子渡越延迟。
AI.method: 片上太赫兹光电子采样 + 热蒸发欧姆接触，消除外部寄生延迟；在零偏压下捕获未封装TMDCs的本征界面光响应；结合空间扫描、偏压依赖测量与超快泵浦-探测光谱。
AI.result: MoS2/Au弛豫寿命48.5 ps、MoSe2/Ag为14.2 ps，对应本征3-dB带宽4.4 GHz和7.5 GHz；响应与位置无关、对偏压免疫，排除漂移限制输运；宏观响应时间与由本征声子瓶颈决定的光-声子散射寿命定量同步。
AI.conclusion: 确立声子工程作为调控非平衡光电子动力学的可行范式，为设计零偏、超快、自供电器件提供蓝图。

title: First-principles investigation of structural, mechanical, vibrational, thermal, electronic and optical properties of Na3Bi: a topological Dirac semimetal
summary: Exploring the properties of topological materials has remained an active area of research in condensed matter physics for the past few decades. Here, we present a first-principles investigation of the structural, elasto-mechanical, thermal, electronic, and optical properties of Na3Bi, one of the earliest discovered topological Dirac semimetals, using density functional theory. The hexagonal phase of Na3Bi is found to be both mechanically and dynamically stable, exhibiting moderate elastic anisotropy with a universal anisotropy index of 0.832. The compound displays a moderate machinability index of 2.386 alongside a low hardness value of 2.005, consistent with its predominantly brittle, covalently bonded character accompanied by a slight metallic contribution. Its comparatively low Debye temperature of 181.39K points to a mechanically soft lattice with loosely bound atoms. Electronic structure calculations confirm semimetallic behavior, with well-defined Dirac points pinned at the Fermi level and a Fermi surface composed of point-like pockets. Optical analysis across a wide spectral range reveals non-selective, moderate reflectivity of 40 to 45% and, in the visible region, an unusually high refractive index reaching between 2 and 4.5. Na3Bi is additionally found to be an efficient absorber of ultraviolet radiation. Together, these findings establish a comprehensive baseline for the mechanical, thermal, and optical behavior of hexagonal Na3Bi and point to its potential relevance for acoustic damping, UV-sensing, and optoelectronic applications

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理（DFT）系统研究了拓扑狄拉克半金属Na3Bi的结构、力热、电子与光学性质，确认其六方相稳定并揭示其在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 拓扑材料的物性研究是凝聚态物理的活跃方向，而作为最早发现的拓扑狄拉克半金属之一，Na3Bi缺乏对其力学、热学与光学行为的系统基线认识，因此需要全面的第一性原理刻画。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）进行第一性原理计算，考察六方相Na3Bi的结构、弹性和力学稳定性、热学性质、电子结构及宽光谱范围的光学响应。
AI.result: 六方Na3Bi同时具备力学和动力学稳定性；弹性各向异性适中（通用各向异性指数0.832）；可加工性指数2.386、硬度2.005，呈现以脆性共价键为主、略带金属性的特征；德拜温度较低（181.39 K），表明晶格较软、原子束缚较弱。电子结构确认半金属行为，狄拉克点钉扎于费米能级，费米面由点状口袋构成。光学上表现出40–45%的非选择性中等反射率，可见区折射率异常高达2–4.5，且是高效的紫外吸收体。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为六方Na3Bi的力学、热学与光学行为建立了全面的基线数据，并指出其在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电子应用方面的潜在价值。

title: Efficient protocol for the Markovian Mpemba effect in $N$-level systems
summary: The Mpemba effect is an anomalous phenomenon in which the time to thermalize does not depend monotonically on the distance from equilibrium, allowing systems with an initially larger temperature difference to thermalize before those with a smaller one. The rarity of the effect makes it hard to find parameters that produce it, complicating the design of experiments and the development of applications. Here, we find necessary and sufficient conditions for the Markovian Mpemba effect in three-level systems and explain its underlying physical mechanisms. Based on our understanding of the three-level case, we develop an efficient algorithm to determine the parameters for the effect in $N$-level systems. This protocol could open the door for the realization of Mpemba experiments and related applications in large systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三能级系统中的马尔可夫 Mpemba 效应，给出其充要条件并阐明物理机制，进而提出在 N 能级系统中寻找该效应参数的高效算法。
AI.motivation: Mpemba 效应（初始温度差更大者反而先热化）较为罕见，难以找到产生该效应的参数，从而给实验设计与应用开发带来困难。
AI.method: 针对三能级系统推导马尔可夫 Mpemba 效应的充要条件并解释其物理机制；基于对三能级情形理解，设计高效算法确定 N 能级系统中产生该效应的参数。
AI.result: 获得了三能级系统马尔可夫 Mpemba 效应的充要条件，并给出可扩展到 N 能级系统的高效参数搜索算法。
AI.conclusion: 该协议有望推动 Mpemba 效应实验及大系统中的相关应用实现。

title: Fast, Accurate, and Scalable Fermionic Neural Networks via Translation Equivariance
summary: We demonstrate that designing a neural quantum state to be an exact eigenstate of the Hamiltonian's symmetries significantly improves both training speed and final variational energy. For the 2D electron gas, we design TorFormer, a neural network wavefunction which is an exact eigenstate of the total momentum. TorFormer describes both the Fermi liquid and Wigner crystal with no supervision and significantly outperforms Psiformer-based references up to large system sizes. For $r_s = 30.0$ and $40.0$ at $N=91$, we compare TorFormer trained for $8\mathrm{K}$ steps against the previous best NQS, which required $100\mathrm{K}$ training steps. Our improvement to the total energy at $r_s = 40.0$, excluding the trivial Madelung part, is $0.12\%$---enormous compared to the tiny differences separating phases. Relative to Slater-Jastrow-backflow diffusion Monte Carlo, TorFormer's energy decrease is roughly $9.8$ times that of the previous best NQS. Our work demonstrates that neural quantum states can both accurately and efficiently solve large-scale problems.

AI.tldr: 设计严格满足哈密顿量对称性的神经量子态（TorFormer），显著提升训练速度与变分能量精度，高效求解二维电子气体多体问题。
AI.motivation: 神经量子态（NQS）虽强大但训练慢、精度受限；若将哈密顿量的对称性（如总动量）内嵌为严格本征态，有望同时加速训练并提升最终变分能量。
AI.method: 针对二维电子气体，设计 TorFormer 神经网络波函数，使其为总动量的精确本征态；无需监督即可同时描述费米液体与维格纳晶体，并在大体系下与 Psiformer 基线对比。
AI.result: TorFormer 大幅超越 Psiformer 类方法。在 N=91、r_s=30.0/40.0 下，仅训练 8K 步即优于需 100K 步的前最佳 NQS；r_s=40.0 时（除去平凡 Madelung 项）总能量改进 0.12%；相对 Slater-Jastrow-backflow DMC，能量下降约为此前最佳 NQS 的 9.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将对称性精确嵌入神经量子态可精确且高效地求解大规模多体问题，展现出 NQS 的实际求解能力与效率优势。

title: Hydrodynamic magnetotransport in a GaAs Corbino geometry
summary: We report the observation of positive magnetoresistance in high-mobility GaAs Corbino devices. Over a broad intermediate-temperature range, the resistance exhibits a quadratic dependence on perpendicular magnetic field. We analyze the data within hydrodynamic theories of magnetotransport in the Corbino geometry, which describe the crossover between the diffusive and viscous regimes, including finite-slip boundary conditions appropriate for current-penetrable contacts. The extracted relaxation rates are consistent with an approximately $T^2$ temperature dependence of the electron-electron scattering contribution. The extracted viscous relaxation parameters are consistent with those obtained from Hall-bar measurements. Comparison with theory indicates that the observed magnetoresistance is predominantly governed by the bulk hydrodynamic response, while finite slip modifies the Stokes--Ohm crossover quantitatively and the field-dependent boundary voltage provides a separate correction. These results show that Corbino magnetotransport can serve as a complementary bulk-sensitive probe of viscous electron flow.

AI.tldr: 该文在高迁移率GaAs Corbino器件中观测到正磁阻，电阻在中等温区随垂直磁场呈二次依赖，并用含有限滑移边界条件的流体动力学理论分析，表明主要由体态流体动力学响应主导，Corbino几何可作为探测粘滞电子流的体敏感互补探针。
AI.motivation: 粘滞电子流通常借助Hall-bar等测量研究，但这类几何对边界条件与接触效应较敏感，缺乏对体态流体动力学响应的直接、敏感探测手段。作者希望利用Corbino几何的体敏感特性，补充现有测量方式。
AI.method: 在高迁移率GaAs Corbino器件中测量磁阻，发现中等温区电阻对垂直磁场呈二次依赖；采用描述扩散—粘滞区交叉的Corbino磁输运流体动力学理论（含适用于电流可穿透接触的有限滑移边界条件）拟合数据，并提取弛豫率与粘滞弛豫参数，与Hall-bar测量结果对比。
AI.result: 观察到正磁阻且呈二次磁场依赖；提取的弛豫率与电子-电子散射贡献近似T²温度依赖一致；粘滞弛豫参数与Hall-bar结果相符；理论比较表明磁阻主要由体态流体动力学响应主导，有限滑移定量修正Stokes–Ohm交叉，场依赖边界电压提供额外修正。
AI.conclusion: Corbino磁输运可作为体敏感的互补探针，用于研究粘滞电子流，并与Hall-bar测量相互印证。

title: Morphology and depletion force-based large-scale self-assembly of nanocubes on surface
summary: Self-assembling nanoparticles is a highly efficient and facile way to form functional nano-, micro- and macrostructures. However, currently available methods lack precision and controllability in size, shape and composition, suffer from poor reproducibility and scalability, and require complex steps and expensive materials. Here, we present the uniform morphology-induced and depletion force-directed nanoparticle assembly on surface (MIDAS) method with gold nanocubes (AuNCs). Using this approach, morphology-sensitive depletion forces trigger shape-selective flocculation and assembly of the AuNCs with uniform size and shape. Importantly, the surface roughness-controlled substrate drives the large-scale formation of AuNC-assembled monolayers (2D AuNAMs) or three-dimensional AuNC-assembled multilayers (3D AuNAMs) in a highly specific manner without any complex ligand modification or preparation steps. Lattice-gas modeling and kinetic Monte Carlo simulations show the depletion force is the key parameter determining supercrystal morphology and corroborate the experimental findings. This work establishes a generalizable nanoparticle assembly mechanism and demonstrates the broad applicability of the MIDAS strategy for scalable fabrication and patterning of 2D and 3D nanoparticle architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIDAS方法，利用形状敏感的耗尽力在基底上组装金纳米立方体，实现2D/3D纳米颗粒超晶格的可控制备。
AI.motivation: 现有自组装方法在尺寸、形状、组分上缺乏精度和可控性，重现性与可扩展性差，且步骤复杂、材料昂贵。
AI.method: 以金纳米立方体（AuNCs）为对象，采用均匀形貌诱导、耗尽力导向的表面组装（MIDAS）；通过表面粗糙度调控基底，无需配体修饰，选择性形成2D单层或3D多层结构；并用晶格气模型与动力学蒙特卡洛模拟验证。
AI.result: 形状敏感的耗尽力驱动AuNCs发生形状选择性絮凝与组装；基底粗糙度可控地大规模形成2D AuNAMs或3D AuNAMs；模拟表明耗尽力是决定超晶形貌的关键参数，且与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一种通用的纳米颗粒组装机制，并展示了MIDAS在可扩展制备与图案化2D、3D纳米颗粒结构方面的广泛适用性。

title: Infinite ergodic theory and functional statistics of non-confined Feller process
summary: We study additive observables of a non-confined Feller process characterized by a non- normalizable stationary probability density and return times with infinite mean. The process is equivalent, after a deterministic rescaling, to a squared Bessel process, but we focus here on a question: the spatial structure of its local-time field. We show that the local time admits a fac- torization in the long time limit. Its spatial profile is governed by the non-normalizable stationary density, whereas its temporal fluctuations are controlled by a single Mittag-Leffler random ampli- tude. As a consequence, normalized spatial correlations of the local time converge to a universal constant independent of the two observation levels. Occupation times of finite intervals follow as corollaries and display Darling-Kac fluctuations. In contrast, non-integrable power observables exhibit self-similar squared-Bessel-type limits rather than Mittag-Leffler statistics. This spatial- field perspective provides a unifying framework for infinite ergodic theory under state-dependent multiplicative noise.

AI.tldr: 研究非受限Feller过程加性可观测量的局域时场空间结构，发现长时极限下局域时可因式分解，空间剖面由不可归一化平稳密度决定，时间涨落由单个Mittag-Leffler随机振幅控制。
AI.motivation: 探讨具不可归一化平稳概率密度、无穷平均返回时间的非受限Feller过程的加性可观测量，核心问题是其局域时场的空间结构。
AI.method: 经确定性重标度将过程等价为平方Bessel过程，分析其局域时在长时间极限下的因式分解结构，并考察占据时间与非可积幂次可观测量的极限行为。
AI.result: 局域时可因式分解为不可归一化平稳密度描述的空间剖面与单一Mittag-Leffler随机振幅控制的时间涨落；归一化空间相关收敛到与观测水平无关的普适常数；有限区间占据时间呈Darling-Kac涨落；非可积幂可观测则呈自相似平方Bessel型极限而非Mittag-Leffler统计。
AI.conclusion: 该空间场视角为态依赖乘性噪声下的无穷遍历理论提供了统一框架。

title: Gauge mean-field theories of the underscreened Kondo lattice
summary: Various mean-field decoupling schemes have been introduced thus far to study the important and challenging problem of the spin-$1$ underscreened Kondo lattice where magnetic order can coexist with Kondo hybridization. We use a single control parameter $N$ and an unbiased variational ansatz to unify and connect the previously proposed decouplings to standard Read-Newns theory, where fluctuations are small in $1/N$. We compute the corrections around the large-$N$ limit. In particular, we make contact with Nozières strong-coupling theory by finding the residual ferromagnetic Hund interaction that decays logarithmically in the case of a heavy-fermion metal. We map out the ground state phase diagram as a function of $N$ and the Kondo coupling. We find crucial differences between the previously proposed mean-field theories in the strength of the hybridization and total magnetization of the coexistent phase. We show that, within our unifying variational theory, the previously proposed decouplings correspond to either taking $N=2$ from the start, or performing a $1/N$ expansion and then extrapolating to $N=2$. Finally, we summarize the generalization of our theory to $S>1$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出含单参数N的无偏变分方法，统一并联系了自旋1欠屏蔽Kondo晶格的各种平均场退耦方案，并计算大N极限的修正。
AI.motivation: 自旋1欠屏蔽Kondo晶格中磁序可与Kondo杂化共存，此问题困难且此前多种平均场退耦方案彼此不统一，需要理论框架将它们与标准Read-Newns理论联系并澄清差异。
AI.method: 引入单控制参数N和无偏变分拟设，在大N极限下计算1/N修正；与Nozières强耦合理论联系，寻找重费米子金属中对数衰减的残余铁磁Hund相互作用；绘制以N和Kondo耦合为变量的基态相图，分析已有退耦方案。
AI.result: 发现已提出平均场理论在共存相的杂化强度和总磁化上存在关键差异；证明这些退耦对应于从一开始取N=2，或做1/N展开后外推到N=2。
AI.conclusion: 统一的变分理论澄清了自旋1欠屏蔽Kondo晶格平均场方法的联系与差异，并总结了理论向S>1的推广。

title: Symplectic Hopf Insulator: Delicate Topology in Bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes Systems
summary: Recent advances in topological phases have highlighted the role of symplectic (Krein-space) topology in the classification of bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BBdG) systems. In this work, we construct a BBdG realization of Hopf topology, which we dub the symplectic Hopf insulator, starting from a microscopic Bose-Hubbard generalization of the Moore-Ran-Wen model with weak on-site interactions treated within a Bogoliubov approximation. The resulting BBdG system admits a symplectic Hopf invariant, which we show to be integer-quantized for isolated bands. We establish that this topology is intrinsically delicate, requiring exactly two bosonic modes per unit cell, while remaining robust against weak interactions over a range of mass parameters. Upon terminating the three-dimensional insulator at a boundary, we find topologically protected in-gap surface states at finite excitation energy, whose protection is itself delicate. Our results establish the symplectic Hopf insulator as a robust yet delicate topological phase in weakly interacting bosonic systems lying beyond the tenfold-way classification.

AI.tldr: 本文在弱相互作用玻色系统中构造了"辛Hopf绝缘体"，一种超出十重分类的辛（Krein空间）拓扑相。
AI.motivation: 拓扑相位研究揭示了辛（Krein空间）拓扑在玻色Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BBdG）系统分类中的作用，但Hopf拓扑在BBdG系统中的实现尚未被探索。
AI.method: 从Moore-Ran-Wen模型的微观Bose-Hubbard推广出发，在Bogoliubov近似下处理弱在位相互作用，构造BBdG实现，并分析其辛Hopf不变量与边界态。
AI.result: BBdG系统具有对孤立能带整数量子化的辛Hopf不变量；该拓扑本质上是"脆弱的"，需每原胞恰好两个玻色模式，但对一定质量参数范围内的弱相互作用保持稳健；三维绝缘体边界上存在有限激发能的拓扑保护带内表面态，其保护本身也是脆弱的。
AI.conclusion: 辛Hopf绝缘体是弱相互作用玻色系统中一种既稳健又脆弱的拓扑相，超出了十重分类框架。

title: Facile hBN-hBN Interfacial Overlap Engineering for Enhanced Quantum Emitter Formation
summary: Quantum emitters in two-dimensional materials, particularly hBN, are promising platforms for quantum technologies. However, achieving high-density emitters at predetermined locations while preserving optical quality remains challenging. Here, we introduce a facile, cost-effective double-layer all-dry transfer approach to deterministically create overlap regions between hBN flakes. These pre-defined capped regions exhibit a significantly enhanced emitter density, with up to a 15-fold increase compared to uncapped areas. Importantly, this method does not compromise emitter quality: emitters within overlap regions demonstrate excellent optical performance, including high signal-to-background and signal-to-noise ratios, large Debye-Waller factors, high brightness, and strong spectral stability. Possible defect configurations are also discussed to contextualize the observed emission characteristics. This scalable strategy enables preferential formation of quantum emitters in targeted regions, achieving higher densities than simple treatments such as plasma irradiation while avoiding the complexity of advanced fabrication techniques. The approach provides a practical pathway for integrating high-quality quantum emitters into scalable quantum photonic platforms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种双层全干法转移技术，通过制造hBN薄片重叠区实现高密度、高质量量子发射体的确定性定位，密度提升达15倍。
AI.motivation: 二维材料（尤其hBN）中的量子发射体是量子技术的重要平台，但在预定位置实现高密度且保持光学质量的发射体仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用简便、低成本的双层全干法转移方法，在hBN薄片间确定性制造重叠区域（预定义的覆盖区）来生成量子发射体。
AI.result: 重叠区发射体密度相比未覆盖区提升高达15倍；发射体光学性能优异：高信背比与信噪比、大Debye-Waller因子、高亮度、强光谱稳定性。并讨论了可能的缺陷构型。
AI.conclusion: 该可扩展策略可在目标区域优先形成量子发射体，密度高于等离子体辐照等简单处理，且避免复杂制造工艺，为将高质量量子发射体集成到可扩展量子光子平台提供实用途径。

title: Anizotropic Ising Model on 2D Kagomé Lattice as an Inhomogeneous XYZ Integrable Model
summary: We investigate a generalized inhomogeneous two-dimensional Ising model on the kagomé lattice with two alternating couplings $J_i$ and $J'_i$, $i=1,2,3$, along the three lattice directions. The local Boltzmann weights are mapped onto a non-symmetric eight-vertex $R$-matrix satisfying the free-fermion condition for arbitrary values of the six couplings. We analyze the Yang--Baxter structure for the cases $J'_i=J_i$ and $J'_i=-J_i$ and derive the corresponding one-dimensional quantum spin chains in the anisotropic limit. The first case yields a transverse-field Ising-type Hamiltonian, while the second leads to a modified chain with a graded permutation structure and shifted partition-function zeros. For a partially anisotropic model, we also obtain the free energy and specific heat.

AI.tldr: 研究kagomé格子上广义非均匀二维Ising模型，映射到满足自由费米子条件的非对称八顶点R矩阵，分析Yang-Baxter结构并导出一维量子自旋链。
AI.motivation: kagomé格子上带交替耦合的广义非均匀Ising模型及其可积结构与量子链对应关系尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 将局部Boltzmann权重映射到满足自由费米子条件的非对称八顶点R矩阵；分别在J'_i=J_i与J'_i=-J_i情形分析Yang-Baxter结构，并在各向异性极限下导出一维量子自旋链哈密顿量；对部分各向异性模型计算自由能与比热。
AI.result: J'_i=J_i情形给出横场Ising型哈密顿量；J'_i=-J_i情形给出具有分级置换结构的修正链，且配分函数零点发生移动；部分各向异性模型获得自由能与比热。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在自由费米子条件下可积，其Yang-Baxter结构对应两类不同的一维量子链，揭示了耦合符号对量子链结构与临界性质的调控作用。

title: uFlowCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction using Mean flow generative models
summary:
Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is fundamental to computational materials discovery. Generative models including CDVAE, DiffCSP, FlowMM, and CrystalFlow learn stable-crystal distributions directly, but diffusion and flow-matching inference requires tens to thousands of sequential network evaluations per candidate.
  We introduce uFlowCSP, a MeanFlow-based CSP model that learns the average, rather than instantaneous, probability-flow velocity. It generates a complete structure in one to five evaluations, delivering 5x-58x faster inference with equal or better performance. A chemistry- and symmetry-aware Transformer uses canonical atom ordering, global composition, and per-token chemistry embeddings. A coarse crystal-system token is used only during training; it provides additive gains, particularly improving space-group agreement despite being absent at inference, which remains formula-only.
  On MP-20 with 20 candidates per target, one step matches CrystalFlow (78.38% vs. 78.34%) with 100x fewer evaluations and about 10x lower wall-clock time. Five steps reach 83.64%, exceeding CrystalFlow (78.34% at 2,000 evaluations) and DiffCSP (77.93% at about 20,000), while using 20x fewer evaluations. uFlowCSP generates 10,000 structures in 0.39-1.31 minutes, versus 6.5 for CrystalFlow and 76.1 for DiffCSP. Under CSPBench's energy-ranked top-five structure-and-space-group criterion, five-step uFlowCSP reaches 72%/72%/65% structure, space-group, and consensus match rates. CrystalFlow reaches 78%/73%/68% at 100 steps but falls to 49%/32%/31% at five. Thus, uFlowCSP improves accuracy per network evaluation, not merely peak accuracy.

AI.tldr: uFlowCSP提出基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型，学习平均概率流速度，单步到五步即可生成结构，实现5-58倍加速且性能相当或更优。
AI.motivation: 生成式CSP方法（如CDVAE、DiffCSP、FlowMM、CrystalFlow）需数十至数千次顺序网络评估，推理成本高，亟需高效生成方法来提升晶体检视发现中的计算效率。
AI.method: 采用MeanFlow学习平均概率流速度（非瞬时速度），实现1-5步生成；使用化学与对称性感知的Transformer，包含规范原子排序、全局组成和逐token化学嵌入；训练时额外使用粗粒度的晶系token，仅训练期提供增益，推理仅依赖化学式。
AI.result: MP-20上，单步与CrystalFlow相当（78.38% vs 78.34%），评估次数少100倍、墙钟时间约低10倍；五步达83.64%，超越CrystalFlow和DiffCSP。生成10000个结构仅0.39-1.31分钟（CrystalFlow 6.5分钟，DiffCSP 76.1分钟）。CSPBench下五步uFlowCSP结构/空间群/一致性匹配72%/72%/65%，CrystalFlow五步仅49%/32%/31%。
AI.conclusion: uFlowCSP通过MeanFlow提升每次网络评估的精度而非仅峰值精度，显著加速晶体结构预测，具备高效生成稳定晶体的实用价值。

title: Italian Business-to-Business Invoicing Data: A Network Analysis
summary: We present a comprehensive description of the network of Italian Business-to-Business commercial relationships, based on the universe of electronic invoices collected by the Italian Tax Office. The firm-to-firm detail of the data is exploited to describe the distribution of the numbers of buyers (customers) and sellers (suppliers) per firm, the centrality of each firm in the production network, and the average distance between firms. We characterize for the first time the firm-to-firm network describing the Italian production system, and present its geographic and sectoral breakdown. The analysis reveals heavy tailed distributions for the numbers of buyers and sellers per firm, implying a scale-free structure of the network. The distributions of centrality values display heavy tails as well, indicating a strong concentration of importance in a relatively small number of firms. We estimate the tail exponents for all these distributions, finding in all cases lower exponents for downstream (buyer-side) distributions than for the upstream (seller-side) ones.

AI.tldr: 基于意大利税务局电子发票全量数据，首次刻画意大利企业间商业关系网络，揭示其无标度特征及买卖双方分布的差异。
AI.motivation: 以往缺乏基于全量真实交易数据的企业间网络描述，本文利用意大利电子发票数据填补这一空白，刻画意大利生产系统网络。
AI.method: 利用意大利税务局收集的电子发票全量数据，在企业对企业层面分析每家企业的买方与卖方数量分布、企业在生产网络中的中心性以及企业间平均距离，并按地理和行业维度细分。
AI.result: 买方与卖方数量分布呈重尾，表明网络具无标度结构；中心性分布也呈重尾，说明重要性高度集中于少数企业。所有分布中，下游（买方侧）的尾部指数均低于上游（卖方侧）。
AI.conclusion: 意大利企业间商业网络具有无标度特征且重要性高度集中，买方侧比卖方侧分布更重尾，为理解生产网络结构提供了新证据。

title: Dimensional Control of Excitonic Interactions in Exfoliated 2D Molecular Crystals
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) materials provide unique opportunities to tailor excited-state properties through reduced dimensionality, altered dielectric screening and layer-dependent structural reconstruction. While such effects have been widely explored in norganic systems, their realization in molecular crystals has been limited by the difficulty of controlling thickness at the atomic scale while preserving crystalline order. Here we show that tetracene and three other molecular crystals can be mechanically exfoliated into mono-, few- or multilayer flakes, while retaining crystalline order. This capability enables new studies of molecular crystals across a well defined thickness range within the same structural organization. Thickness-dependent spectra of these samples reveal how out-of-plane confinement modifies the excited-state energy landscape of tetracene: With decreasing thickness, the Davydov splitting diminishes, the Stokes shift increases, and signatures of more delocalized excitons emerge. Electron diffraction and exciton model-based analyses correlate these trends to changes in molecular packing, intermolecular coupling and dielectric screening. Our results also demonstrate that key features of molecular excitons can be systematically tuned by layer number, extending dimensional control from inorganic 2D materials to molecular crystals.

AI.tldr: 该论文实现了四并苯等四种分子晶体的机械剥离，获得保持晶序的单层、少层及多层薄片，并揭示了层数调控下激发态性质（Davydov分裂、Stokes位移、激子离域）的系统变化。
AI.motivation: 二维材料通过降低维度、改变介电屏蔽与层依赖结构重构可调控激发态性质，但这些效应主要在无机体系中探索；分子晶体因难以在保持晶序的同时实现原子级厚度控制而受限。
AI.method: 对四并苯及另外三种分子晶体进行机械剥离，制备单层、少层和多层薄片；通过厚度依赖光谱测量、电子衍射以及基于激子模型的分析，关联分子堆积、分子间耦合与介电屏蔽的变化。
AI.result: 厚度依赖光谱显示：随厚度减小，Davydov分裂减弱、Stokes位移增大、并出现更离域激子的特征；这些趋势与分子堆积、分子间耦合和介电屏蔽的变化相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明分子激子的关键特征可通过层数系统调控，将无机二维材料的维度调控能力拓展至分子晶体。

title: Quantifying translational and bond-orientational order metrics in hyperuniform and nonhyperuniform many-particle systems
summary: Quantifying the degree of order/disorder in many-particle systems remains an outstanding problem in physics, materials science, and mathematics. To this end, we consider the translational order metric $τ_T$, defined as the squared $L^2$ norm of the total correlation function $h(\mathbf{r})$, and introduce its bond-orientational analogue $τ_O$, defined from the weighted total correlation function $h_{\mathbf{f}}(\mathbf{r})$ using local orientational weights (S. Torquato et al., Phys. Rev. X 16, 011042 (2026)). The pair $(τ_T,τ_O)$ places both forms of order on a common two-point statistical footing. We compute both metrics for two nonhyperuniform sphere-packing models in 2D and 3D as functions of packing fraction $φ$: 1) equilibrium hard particles and 2) nonequilibrium random sequential addition (RSA) packings. For the nonhyperuniform systems, bond-orientational order remains subdominant along the equilibrium-fluid and RSA configurations; however, its magnitude relative to the translational metric increases near the upper end of the equilibrium-fluid branches, much more strongly in 2D than in 3D, and the two metrics become comparable along the sampled crystal branches. At common packing fractions, equilibrium fluids and RSA packings trace distinct $(τ_T,τ_O)$ trajectories, revealing preparation-dependent differences in structural order. As a representative hyperuniform family, we study 2D disordered stealthy hyperuniform (SHU) ground states for $0<χ<1/2$, where $χ$ is the stealthiness parameter. Within the disordered SHU phase, bond-orientational order remains subdominant, but its magnitude relative to the translational metric increases toward the disorder-to-order threshold. In all three models, $τ_T$ and $τ_O$ are positively correlated beyond the Poisson-reference regime: $τ_O$ increases monotonically with $τ_T$ across the sampled state points.

AI.tldr: 本文引入键取向序度量τ_O（与平动序度量τ_T配对），在统一的两点统计框架下量化硬球、RSA及二维SHU体系中的序/无序程度。
AI.motivation: 多粒子体系中序/无序的定量刻画仍是物理、材料与数学中的未解难题，需要将平动序与取向序纳入统一统计框架。
AI.method: 定义平动序度量τ_T（总关联函数h(r)的L²范数平方）及键取向类比τ_O（基于局部取向权重的加权总关联函数h_f(r)）；对二维/三维平衡硬粒子、非平衡RSA堆积及二维无序SHU基态计算(τ_T, τ_O)随堆积分数φ（或隐身参数χ）的变化。
AI.result: 非超均匀体系中取向序次主导，但在平衡流体分支高端相对平动度量显著增强（二维强于三维），晶体分支上二者可比；同φ下平衡流体与RSA轨迹不同，体现制备依赖性；无序SHU相中取向序次主导但在接近无序-有序阈值时相对增强；所有体系中τ_O随τ_T单调正相关。
AI.conclusion: (τ_T, τ_O)提供统一的两点统计序度量，可区分不同制备路径与相区，并揭示平动序与取向序的普适正相关关系。

title: Observation of Magnetic-Anisotropy Crossover and High-Temperature Skyrmions in the Dirac Magnet Fe3Ge with a Distorted Kagome Lattice
summary: Topological materials that simultaneously host robust high-temperature skyrmions and nontrivial electronic band structures have attracted tremendous interest owing to their distinctive advantages for both fundamental research and prospective technological applications. Here, we report the observation of robust skyrmions in the Dirac kagome magnet Fe3Ge, which exhibits a high Curie temperature of ~ 650 K. At room temperature, Fe3Ge shows a large intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity of ~ 380 Ω-1cm-1, originating from its nontrivial electronic band topology. Systematic magnetization measurements reveal a spin reorientation transition at ~ 375 K, indicating a crossover from easy-plane to easy-axis magnetic anisotropy. Below the spin reorientation temperature, a large topological Hall effect is observed, arising from microscopic noncoplanar spin structures. Lorentz transmission electron microscopy shows that mesoscopic skyrmions are stabilized in the easy-axis magnetic anisotropy regime and persist over an exceptionally wide temperature window of 375-650 K, far exceeding that of most previously reported skyrmion-hosting materials. These results establish Fe3Ge as a promising platform for exploring diverse topological properties, with strong potential for advancing future high-temperature spintronic applications, ranging from next-generation information storage to logic computing devices.

AI.tldr: 在Dirac kagome磁体Fe3Ge中观测到鲁棒的高温skyrmion，居里温度约650 K，天空子稳定温度窗口达375–650 K，同时具备非平庸电子能带拓扑与大的本征反常霍尔电导。
AI.motivation: 同时具备高温skyrmion与非平庸电子能带结构的拓扑材料，对基础研究和自旋电子学应用都极具吸引力，但此类材料稀缺，因此需要寻找和验证新的候选体系。
AI.method: 综合磁化测量、输运测量（反常霍尔、拓扑霍尔效应）与洛伦兹透射电子显微镜，对Dirac kagome磁体Fe3Ge的磁结构与电子拓扑性质进行系统表征。
AI.result: Fe3Ge居里温度约650 K；室温本征反常霍尔电导约380 Ω⁻¹cm⁻¹，源于非平庸能带拓扑；约375 K发生自旋重取向（易面→易轴）；自旋重取向温度以下出现大拓扑霍尔效应；洛伦兹电镜显示skyrmion在375–650 K宽温区内稳定存在，远超多数已报道的skyrmion材料。
AI.conclusion: Fe3Ge是探索多种拓扑性质的理想平台，在高温自旋电子学器件（如信息存储、逻辑计算）方面具有很大应用潜力。

title: Strong Impact of Halide Ordering on Structural Phase Transitions in Mixed Perovskites
summary: Mixed halide perovskites are highly versatile semiconductors with applications in photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, and photodetectors. Understanding their thermodynamic phase behavior is central to guiding compositional design and improving device stability. Here, we train machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) on density functional theory reference data for CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y, CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y, and CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y halide perovskites, enabling large-scale hybrid Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics simulations that sample both configurational and vibrational degrees of freedom. All three binary halide systems exhibit a miscibility gap, the extent of which correlates with halide ion size mismatch. The gaps in Br-Cl and Br-I close at low temperatures, while the Cl-I gap extends above room temperature. At temperatures above the miscibility gap (200 K to 500 K), all systems show a tendency toward layered halide ordering, with halide species preferentially occupying apical or equatorial octahedral sites. In CsPbBr3yI3-3y, this ordering occurs in a device-relevant temperature regime and is linked to the structural phase transitions, shifting transition temperatures by up to 100 K relative to randomly mixed structures. We attribute the strongly non-linear composition dependence of the orthorhombic-tetragonal phase boundary observed experimentally (a linear decrease followed by a plateau) to halide ordering. Introducing Rb on the A-site weakens halide ordering and eliminates the non-linear behavior, while narrowing the miscibility gap in both the Br-I and Br-Cl systems. These results establish halide ordering as a key determinant of structural phase stability in mixed-halide perovskites.

AI.tldr: 该工作训练机器学习原子间势(MLIP)结合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学混合模拟，揭示了混合卤化物钙钛矿中卤素有序化对其热力学相行为和结构相稳定性的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 混合卤化物钙钛矿在光伏、LED和光电探测器中应用广泛，理解其热力学相行为对组分设计和器件稳定性至关重要，但卤素分布与相行为的关系尚不清晰。
AI.method: 基于DFT参考数据训练MLIP，针对CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y三个体系，进行可同时采样构型与振动自由度的大规模混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟。
AI.result: 三个二元卤化物体系均存在混溶间隙，其范围与卤素离子尺寸失配相关：Br-Cl和Br-I间隙在低温闭合，而Cl-I间隙延伸至室温以上。200–500 K下所有体系倾向形成层状卤素有序（卤素优先占据八面体顶端或赤道位）。CsPbBr3yI3-3y中该有序发生在器件相关温区，并使结构相变温度相对随机混合结构移高达100 K；作者据此解释了正交-四方相边界的强非线性组分依赖。引入A位Rb削弱卤素有序、消除非线性行为，同时缩小Br-I和Br-Cl体系的混溶间隙。
AI.conclusion: 卤素有序化是决定混合卤化物钙钛矿结构相稳定性的关键因素。

title: The Arithmetic of Spectra: Factorization, Statistics, and Symmetric Functions
summary: We study factorizations of the single-particle spectrum of non-interacting quantum systems and their consequences for many-particle statistics. Representing the single-particle partition function by a spectral alphabet, tensor factorizations become multiplicative factorizations of the alphabet, which can be lifted to canonical Bose and Fermi partition functions using standard symmetric-function and $λ$-ring identities. We show how product spectra arise from different factorizations, how antisymmetrization can be assigned across an odd number of factors, and which tensor factorizations are compatible with a fixed spectrum. The paper therefore studies spectral factorization and provides a consolidated combinatorial framework for canonical Bose and Fermi partition functions.

AI.tldr: 本文将非相互作用量子系统的单粒子谱以"谱字母表"(spectral alphabet)表示，使张量因子分解等价于字母表的乘法分解，并借此统一研究Bose与Fermi正则配分函数。
AI.motivation: 研究单粒子谱的因子分解及其对多粒子统计的影响，需要一个统一框架来刻画乘积谱的来源、反对称化在奇数个因子间的分配，以及哪些张量分解与固定谱相容。
AI.method: 用谱字母表表示单粒子配分函数，将张量因子分解转化为字母表的乘法分解；借助标准对称函数与λ-环恒等式把该分解提升为Bose和Fermi正则配分函数。
AI.result: 展示了乘积谱如何由不同因子分解产生，说明了反对称化如何分配到奇数个因子上，并刻画了与固定谱相容的张量因子分解。
AI.conclusion: 该文研究了谱因子分解，并为Bose与Fermi正则配分函数提供了一个整合的组合学框架。

title: Protected domains and the cost of cooperation on weighted networks
summary: A costly inherited trait can spread when its descendants create a favorable local environment. We ask which finite contact structures sustain such a collective competitor and what their advantage costs. Individuals play a donation game, conferring benefit $b$ at cost $c$. Reciprocal weighted contacts determine averaged payoffs and copying recipients, while sources are chosen globally according to payoff. Cooperation is favored when a uniformly introduced cooperator takes over more often than a defector in the complementary experiment. Exact fluctuation response and elimination of fast configurations identify the formation and competition of protected domains as the controlling processes. The sharp weak-selection threshold infima are $b/c=3$ on the four-cycle, $7$ on the five-site path, and $1$ on every fixed path with at least six sites. On the six-site path, a global bound forces near-barrier designs into this domain hierarchy. Polynomial relations among the contact ratios then control unrestricted optimization and imply eventual exact reflection symmetry. Reaching threshold $1+ε$ requires minimum contact contrast $656ε^{-2}[1+O(ε)]$ and neutral absorption time of order $ε^{-1}$. We determine their tradeoff and the associated design tolerance. Finite selection consumes the same margin. Within the controlled small-selection window, the maximal fixation advantage is of order $ε^{5/2}$ when the contrast exceeds its exact minimum by order $ε^{-1}$. Thus an improving invasion threshold can require increasing contact heterogeneity, precision and observation time.

AI.tldr: 论文研究有限接触结构如何维持一种"集体竞争者"（利他性状）的传播，并量化其优势代价。通过捐赠博弈与加权接触网络模型，发现合作受偏好的阈值由受保护域的形成与竞争决定：四环上 b/c=3，五节点路径上为 7，六节点及以上固定路径上为 1。达到阈值 1+ε 需要最小接触对比度约 656ε⁻²，中性吸收时间为 ε⁻¹ 量级，且最大固定优势为 ε^{5/2} 量级，说明改善入侵阈值需要更强的接触异质性、精度与观察时间。
AI.motivation: 继承性的利他性状（如合作）通常自身有代价，但当后代能改善局部环境时仍可传播。作者希望明确：什么样的有限接触结构能维持这种"集体竞争者"，以及获得这种优势需要付出什么代价（阈值、异质性、精度与时间）。
AI.method: 个体进行捐赠博弈，付出成本 c 给出收益 b。带权接触决定平均收益，受赠者复制来源，来源按收益全局选取。合作被偏好定义为：均匀引入的合作者比互补实验中的背叛者更常占据群体。利用精确涨落响应与快速构型消除，识别"受保护域"的形成与竞争为控制过程，并通过接触比的多项式关系分析无限制优化与最终精确反射对称。
AI.result: 弱选择阈值下确界为：四环 b/c=3，五节点路径为 7，所有至少六节点的固定路径为 1。六节点路径上，全局界迫使近屏障设计进入该域层级。达到阈值 1+ε 需要最小接触对比度 656ε⁻²[1+O(ε)]，中性吸收时间为 ε⁻¹ 量级；有限选择消耗同样余量。在受控小选择窗口内，当对比度超过精确最小值约 ε⁻¹ 时，最大固定优势为 ε^{5/2} 量级。
AI.conclusion: 改善入侵阈值往往需要增加接触异质性、提高精度并延长观察时间，且接触对比度、精度与吸收时间之间存在明确的权衡关系与设计容差。

title: pyeCE: A Python Implementation of the Embedded Cluster Expansion
summary: The cluster expansion is a widely used approach for predicting the finite-temperature thermodynamics of alloys from zero-kelvin first-principles calculations, but its conventional formulation becomes intractable for materials with more than three or four chemical species. High-entropy alloys have therefore remained largely out of reach. We present pyeCE, an open-source Python library that implements the embedded cluster expansion (eCE), in which machine learning maps many chemical species onto a smaller set of effective species and thereby limits the growth in the number of cluster functions. pyeCE provides the complete modeling workflow, including the construction of symmetry-adapted descriptors with a learnable per-sublattice chemical embedding, a neural-network energy model, ladder-based training, uncertainty quantification, and finite-temperature simulations through Monte Carlo sampling. Built on the PyTorch and pymatgen libraries, it supports systems with multiple species on multiple sublattices and runs on graphics processing units. We demonstrate the package on two material systems. In the first, a single model spanning the full composition space of a 9-component refractory alloy resolves short-range order and order--disorder behavior. This model enables rapid screening for compositions with strong Cr clustering, a feature linked to the formation of a continuous, corrosion-resistant oxide scale. In the second, a model of hydrogen dissolution in a Mo--Nb--W alloy reproduces the composition dependence of hydrogen uptake and resolves the interstitial environments that hydrogen occupies. The modular design of pyeCE allows it to be extended to problems beyond alloy thermodynamics, including kinetics, defect energetics, and the coupling of chemical order to magnetic and vibrational degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: pyeCE是一个开源Python库，实现嵌入团簇展开（eCE），通过机器学习将多种化学物种映射到较少有效物种，解决了高熵合金等多元体系有限温度热力学预测的难题。
AI.motivation: 传统团簇展开方法在化学物种超过三到四种时变得不可处理，导致高熵合金的有限温度热力学预测长期难以实现，亟需一种能扩展到多元体系的新方法。
AI.method: 提出嵌入团簇展开（eCE）：用机器学习将多化学物种映射到较小有效物种集合以限制团簇函数数量增长。pyeCE提供完整建模流程，包括可学习每子晶格化学嵌入的对称自适应描述符、神经网络能量模型、阶梯式训练、不确定性量化及蒙特卡洛有限温度模拟，基于PyTorch和pymatgen，支持多子晶格多物种并可在GPU运行。
AI.result: 在9组元难熔合金全成分空间用单一模型解析短程有序与有序-无序行为，实现快速筛选强Cr团簇成分（与耐腐蚀连续氧化层相关）；在Mo-Nb-W合金中氢溶解模型重现氢吸收的成分依赖并解析氢占据的间隙环境。
AI.conclusion: pyeCE模块化设计可扩展到合金热力学之外的问题，包括动力学、缺陷能量学以及化学有序与磁性、振动自由度的耦合。

title: Optimal Intermediate Hamiltonians for Non-Equilibrium Free Energy Calculations: A Numerical Study of Markov Models
summary: The Jarzynski relation enables the estimation of equilibrium free energy differences from non-equilibrium, finite-time switching simulations. These estimates usually converge poorly because rare trajectories dominate the exponential work average. Here, we numerically determined and explored the sequence of intermediate Hamiltonians connecting initial and final states that minimize the mean squared error (MSE) of the Jarzynski estimator and thereby enhance convergence. For discrete-time Markov models, an exact tilted-master-equation representation of the MSE in the large-sample limit, combined with automatic differentiation, enables efficient gradient-based minimization over all intermediate energies. We applied our approach to three model systems of increasing complexity: a two-state model, a double-well potential, and a shifted potential well. In all three systems, the optimal intermediate Hamiltonians jump at the initial and final times. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that optimal intermediates can reduce the MSE by more than an order of magnitude compared with linear and logarithmic interpolation, most strongly for large changes in the energy landscape. Remarkably, they need not dissipate less work than intermediates yielding larger errors. Our results suggest heuristics for more efficient non-equilibrium free energy calculations of realistic molecular systems: optimal intermediate Hamiltonians jump at the initial and final times; for barrier-crossing problems, the barrier should be lowered rapidly and raised again later; and minimizing dissipation does not guarantee faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值优化连接初末态中间哈密顿量，最小化Jarzynski估计量的均方误差(MSE)，以提升非平衡自由能计算收敛性。
AI.motivation: Jarzynski关系可从非平衡有限时间切换模拟估计平衡自由能差，但估计通常收敛很差，因为稀有轨迹主导指数工作平均，需要改进中间路径设计来提升收敛。
AI.method: 对离散时间马尔可夫模型，推导大样本极限下MSE的精确倾斜主方程表示，结合自动微分对所有中间能量做高效梯度最小化，并在二态模型、双势阱、平移势阱三个系统中验证。
AI.result: 最优中间哈密顿量在初末时刻发生跳变；相比线性与对数插值，MSE可降低一个数量级以上，能量景观变化大时尤为显著；且最优中间态不一定耗散更少功。
AI.conclusion: 给出高效非平衡自由能计算的启发式策略：最优中间哈密顿量在初末时刻跳变；越垒问题应快速降垒再抬升；最小化耗散并不保证更快收敛。

title: Beyond Impedance Additivity: A Systematic Nonlinear Perspective on Memristor Associations
summary: We investigate the validity of the superposition principle and impedance additivity in AC circuits containing a memristive device connected in series with a resistor, capacitor, or inductor. While the series association of impedances is a cornerstone of linear circuit theory, its applicability to memory-bearing nonlinear systems remains largely unexplored. Using a state-dependent memristive model, we numerically analyze the stationary current response under sinusoidal excitation and characterize the resulting harmonic spectra, Bode diagrams, and Nyquist plots. To assess whether the fundamental response can still be interpreted through an equivalent-circuit framework, we introduce the concept of an apparent memristor, whose effective parameters are extracted directly from the composite impedance. We show that, although the fundamental harmonic can be accurately reproduced by an apparent equivalent circuit over selected parameter ranges, the effective parameters differ substantially from those of the isolated memristor, revealing a renormalization induced by the coupling to the passive element. More importantly, we identify parameter regimes in which the apparent-circuit description breaks down altogether, particularly for capacitor and inductor-coupled systems, demonstrating that the composite impedance cannot generally be expressed as the sum of independent impedances. These results establish boundaries for the use of equivalent-circuit models in memory-enabled electronic systems and provide practical guidelines for the interpretation of impedance spectroscopy in nonlinear devices exhibiting memory.

AI.tldr: 研究含忆阻器与R、C或L串联的交流电路中叠加原理与阻抗可加性的有效性，提出"表观忆阻器"概念，发现等效电路描述在特定参数区间失效，尤其对电容/电感耦合系统。
AI.motivation: 阻抗串联是可加性是线性电路理论的基石，但该原理对含记忆的非线性系统（如忆阻器）是否适用尚不明确，需要界定等效电路模型在记忆型电子系统中的适用范围。
AI.method: 采用状态依赖的忆阻器模型，对正弦激励下的稳态电流响应进行数值分析，表征谐波频谱、Bode图和Nyquist图；引入"表观忆阻器"概念，从复合阻抗中直接提取有效参数，并与孤立忆阻器参数对比。
AI.result: 基波响应在部分参数区间可由表观等效电路准确再现，但有效参数与孤立忆阻器差异显著，表明存在由耦合引起的重正化效应；更关键的是，在电容和电感耦合系统中发现了表观电路描述完全失效的参数区间，复合阻抗无法表示为独立阻抗之和。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了记忆型电子系统中等效电路模型的使用边界，并为含记忆非线性器件的阻抗谱解释提供了实用准则。

title: Structural and Electronic Properties of Bulk $β$(2H)-GaSe from First-Principles DFT Calculations with van der Waals Corrections
summary: Gallium selenide (GaSe) is a layered III-VI semiconductor whose bulk crystal serves as the essential energetic reference for modeling the isolated monolayer. We present a systematic density-functional-theory (DFT) study of the centrosymmetric $β$(2H)-GaSe polymorph, employing the GGA-PBE functional supplemented with a semiempirical Grimme DFT-D2 dispersion correction to accurately capture the weak van der Waals interlayer coupling. The optimized in-plane lattice parameter agrees well with experimental values (within about 1.3%), while the out-of-plane parameter c is overestimated by the DFT-D2 correction relative to experiment, a known limitation of this dispersion scheme when the pairwise $C_6$ coefficients are not specifically fitted for the compound class under study. Electronic structure calculations confirm a non-magnetic, direct-gap profile (1.12 eV). Although this magnitude reflects the well-known underestimation of semilocal functionals, the qualitative band topology accurately captures the intrinsic two-dimensional carrier confinement within the bulk material. Consequently, this optimized three-dimensional framework provides a consistent energetic baseline for quantifying exfoliation processes, offering a reliable starting point for future theoretical explorations of the two-dimensional limit, such as surface functionalization for potential spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文用DFT-D2系统研究了中心对称β-GaSe体相，获得与实验吻合的晶格参数和直接带隙电子结构，为单层建模提供能量参考基线。
AI.motivation: GaSe体相晶体是建模孤立单层的必需能量参考；需要准确描述其弱范德华层间耦合。
AI.method: 采用GGA-PBE泛函加Grimme DFT-D2半经验色散校正，对中心对称β(2H)-GaSe进行系统DFT计算。
AI.result: 面内晶格参数与实验误差约1.3%内；c轴被DFT-D2高估；电子结构为非磁性直接带隙1.12 eV，虽低估但能定性反映二维载流子限域。
AI.conclusion: 优化的三维框架为剥离过程量化提供一致的能量基线，是未来二维极限研究（如表面功能化用于自旋电子学）的可靠起点。

title: Spectroscopic signatures of mode-selective electron-phonon coupling in transient reflectivity change on charge-density-wave TiSe$_2$
summary: We report on time- and spectrally resolved pump-probe spectroscopy measurement on the charge-density wave (CDW) state of TiSe$_2$ at helium temperatures. The non-oscillatory component of the spectrally resolved signals exhibit a sign reversal near 1.5 eV, which was interpreted as a redshift of the optical transition energy originated from the interband transition between the Se $p$-based valence band to the Ti $d$-derived conduction band. Furthermore, the oscillatory components exhibit distinct spectral dependences between the optical phonons and the CDW-derived modes, suggesting the mode-selective coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间与频谱分辨的泵浦-探测光谱，研究低温下TiSe₂电荷密度波(CDW)态的激发动力学，非振荡信号在~1.5 eV出现符号反转，振荡信号在光学声子与CDW衍生模式间呈现不同频谱依赖。
AI.motivation: 探究TiSe₂的CDW态在超快激发下的光学响应与声子/模式耦合机制。
AI.method: 氦温度下对TiSe₂ CDW态进行时间分辨、频谱分辨的泵浦-探测光谱测量，分析非振荡与振荡分量随能量的变化。
AI.result: 非振荡信号在~1.5 eV附近符号反转，解释为Se p价带到Ti d导带间带间跃迁的光学跃迁能量红移；振荡信号在光学声子和CDW衍生模式间具有不同的频谱依赖。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了带间跃迁的红移行为及模式选择性耦合，表明不同声子模式与电子态耦合存在差异。

title: Overcoming Transport Layer Bottlenecks to Quantify Ionic Parameters from Transient Ion Current Measurements of Perovskite Solar Cells
summary: In perovskite solar cells (PSCs), voltage step-induced transient ion current (TIC) measurements, commonly referred to as bias-assisted charge extraction (BACE), are frequently used to quantify ion density. Drift-diffusion simulations predict that the ion density computed from TIC saturates once mobile ions screen the electric field in the perovskite. However, experimental studies often report ion densities orders of magnitude above this limit, whose physical origin remains incompletely explained in terms of transport layer (TL) properties. In this work, the capacitance of the TLs is identified to be the fundamental bottleneck: the maximum quantifiable ion density is limited to the charge that can accumulate at the perovskite/TL interfaces, so that TIC most often depends more strongly on TL properties than on the ionic properties of the perovskite. Experiments with systematically varied C$_{\rm 60}$ electron-TL thickness (p-i-n) and Spiro-OMeTAD hole-TL doping (n-i-p) confirm this dependence across architectures. To overcome this limitation, the importance of a correction based on the average ionic displacement is discussed, and it is shown how extrapolating the TL-thickness trend towards the TL-free situation yields the actual ionic conductivity of the absorber, alongside density and mobility, depending on the assumed ionic model. Simulations are also examined in which ion penetration into the TLs or initial accumulation under forward bias raise the capacitive limit and extend TIC sensitivity to higher ion densities. The slow release of trapped carriers is also discussed as a potential source of current which can inflate the TIC signal. Overall, the presented analysis provides important practical considerations for interpreting TIC and quantifying ionic properties in PSCs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出钙钛矿太阳能电池中瞬态离子电流(TIC/BACE)测得的离子密度受传输层电容限制，而非钙钛矿本征离子性质，并提出修正与无TL外推方法获取真实离子参数。
AI.motivation: 漂移-扩散模拟预测TIC测得的离子密度在电场被屏蔽后会饱和，但实验报道的离子密度常高出该极限数个数量级，其物理根源（尤其是传输层性质的影响）尚未被充分解释。
AI.method: 论文通过系统性实验改变C60电子传输层厚度(p-i-n)与Spiro-OMeTAD空穴传输层掺杂(n-i-p)，结合漂移-扩散模拟，考察TL电容对TIC的影响。
AI.result: 识别出TL电容是根本瓶颈：可测离子密度上限受限于钙钛矿/TL界面可累积电荷，TIC信号更强依赖TL性质而非钙钛矿离子性质；实验在两种架构中验证了该依赖性。提出基于平均离子位移的修正，并通过对TL厚度趋势外推至无TL情形获得吸收层真实离子电导率、密度与迁移率；模拟显示离子穿透TL或正偏初始累积可提高电容极限并扩展TIC灵敏度；同时讨论陷阱载流子缓释会膨胀TIC信号。
AI.conclusion: 该分析为正确解读TIC信号、准确量化钙钛矿太阳能电池离子性质提供了重要的实践指导与修正方法。
